business: Money Spending Board (personal budgeting web app, Thai and English)
target: Thai adults who want to track everyday spending from their bank slips and credit-card statements without typing every transaction by hand
where: Thailand, online (web app, installable as PWA)

behaviours.name: Slip keeper
behaviours.how: Screenshots every bank transfer and wants them in one place.

behaviours.name: Card-statement reviewer
behaviours.how: Reads the monthly credit-card statement and wants categories without retyping.

behaviours.name: Budget planner
behaviours.how: Wants a simple needs / savings / wants split and checks it monthly.

behaviours.name: Tried and quit
behaviours.how: Downloaded a budget app before, stopped after a few weeks because of manual entry.

behaviours.name: Spreadsheet user
behaviours.how: Already tracks in Google Sheets or Excel and does not want to switch.

behaviours.name: Privacy-cautious
behaviours.how: Unwilling to share bank data or upload statements to a new app.

objections: Is my bank information safe if the app reads my slips?
My bank app already shows my history
I already keep a spreadsheet and it works
I'll forget to scan the slips every day
The iPhone Shortcut setup looks complicated, even with a video
Free budget apps already do this
I don't know if it works with my bank or my card
habits: you transfer money to family and friends through K PLUS, BBL or TTB most weeks
you get a credit-card statement at the end of each month
you have a monthly salary and try to save something each month
